data.description:
## Context / Problem
Five approved prose upgrades to the implement-side skill and the shared test-design doc, targeting the largest escape classes: parity siblings at build time, config read-but-miswired, op-level contention semantics, gate findings fixed without oracle upgrades, and known gaps evaporating at close. (Bug-trend review changes 18-22; enforcement twins deliberately not proposed where FP modes dominate.)

## Approach
All prose, no new gate machinery:
(18) SKILL.md 4a surface-parity census: when the change touches one of several parallel surfaces, run the same 5-slot channel census as the debug skill (CLI / MCP-API / library-facade / automated-callers / dual-direction) — each slot in-scope-and-proven-through-that-surface or out-of-scope-with-reason (feeds the Phase-5 sweep).
(19) test-design.md §6 config-effect contrast: for each config key the change reads or should read, one test proving the key CHANGES BEHAVIOR through the real read path (default vs non-default contrast), not merely that a value is parsed — targets the read-but-miswired class (9d7a: honored by MCP server, ignored by comment tool).
(20-prose) SKILL.md contention triggers, narrowed to op-level semantics (case c): if the change (i) composes >=2 locked operations or check-then-act across store reads/writes, (ii) adds its own retry/backoff/reclamation logic, or (iii) introduces a cache/snapshot over store state — add contention cases to the EXISTING shared suites (tests/integration/test_concurrency_regression.py two_clones fixture; storm suite), never a bespoke harness. Changes riding existing seams (single locked op) are exempt.
(21) SKILL.md 4g gate-finding oracle upgrade: a behavioral gate finding gets a RED test FIRST in the same amended change, then the fix; non-behavioral (naming/docs/style) fixed directly — exemption stated to prevent change-detector tests.
(22) Phase 5 + Reporting residual-gap disposition sweep over an enumerable source checklist (4a census out-of-scope slots, 4b exclusions, 4e-bis compromises, deferred 4g advisories): each item filed (ticket + discovered_from) / accepted-with-reason / fixed; 'none' legitimate.

## Scope
- examples/agent-skills/rebar-implement/SKILL.md (4a, contention trigger block, 4g, Phase 5, Reporting)
- examples/agent-skills/shared/test-design.md §6 (+ sync of per-skill copies enforced by tests/unit/test_skill_shared_sync.py)

## Testing
Prose-only: skill sync test must stay green (test_skill_shared_sync.py); dry-run read-through of the census + contention triggers against two historical bugs (9d7a config-miswire; ed2b pagination-under-writes).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All five prose blocks landed at the named anchors; no new gate machinery introduced.
- [ ] Contention trigger text scopes to the three case-c shapes and routes cases to the existing shared suites by path.
- [ ] Shared test-design.md copies in sync (test green).
- [ ] Census slots and disposition checklist use forced-artifact wording (in-scope-proven / out-of-scope-reason / filed / accepted / fixed).
